newsitem.title: TUNISIA: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.
newsitem.headline: Tunis bourse index closes down in lower trade.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Friday closed down by 0.43 percent in reduced trade, bourse sources said.
The 31-share index closed at 502.57 from 504.73 on Thursday.
Total volume was 1.38 million dinars against 7.01 million dinars.
Detergents firm SPCD dropped 1.14 dinar to 36.86 dinars. UBCI bank was down 0.96 dinar to 51.02 dinars. Cola and beer bottler SFBT declined 0.5 dinar to 92 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air eased 0.3 dinar to 24.1 dinars with 6,658 shares changing hands. Chemical firm al-Kimia edged lower 0.3 dinar to 51 dinars.
BIAT bank which plans to increase its capital by 20 million dinars to 80 million dinars and is to hold its annual general assembly on May 14 was up 0.86 dinar to 38 dinars. ($1= 1.09 dinar)
